scope: Sequential clean reruns after the competing workload was stopped or paused. Finite complete fixtures and bounded full 160-cell searches are distinguished; no complete original Gold solve.

recommendation.scope: Best GPU policy among the measured profiles for these bounded identical-frontier comparisons, not a CPU versus GPU solve-time winner.
recommendation.duration: Unlimited is available for actual search; the diagnostic benchmark was bounded.
recommendation.symmetry_note: Verified fresh-board symmetry reduces the representative search space by ten proper rotations, but MRV plus symmetry was not measured separately. Each feature policy has a separate checkpoint; old coverage is not transferred.

gpu.weighting: For each completed fixed prefix of length L, count (160-L)!*3**(160-L). Subtract the identical initial warmup-completed prefix set. L3 weighs471 times L4. Counts describe exact raw labelled subspaces excluded by necessary conditions, not physical iteration of every board.

weighted_coverage_contract.constructor_guard: Frozen fullboard-source/dfs_gpu.py lines68-73 and174 normalize every supplied fixed prefix and reject duplicates or ancestor/descendant overlaps before launching GPU work.
weighted_coverage_contract.mixed_depth_scope: No counted L4 prefix can extend a counted L3 prefix: the complete initial selected population is prefix-free under one fixed fill order. Dynamic MRV only changes variable order below each owned prefix.
weighted_coverage_contract.no_refill_or_reassignment: benchmark_gpu_profiles_v3.py constructs one fresh engine per profile and never refills lanes during its measured slice; a state2 exhausted job stays exhausted.
weighted_coverage_contract.pre_run_subtraction: initial_states is captured after constructor and warmup, before measurement. The weighted sum of every state2 prefix in initial_states is subtracted from the final state2 weighted sum. All four paired runs initially exclude1745 length3 and1856 length4 prefixes; surplus/unowned lanes are excluded via states[:len(ids)].
weighted_coverage_contract.raw_orientation_labels: Weight (160-L)!*3**(160-L) counts raw assignments of the remaining distinct physical-piece labels and three labelled rotations. Necessary conditions may exclude these boards without individually generating them.
weighted_coverage_contract.paired_profiles: Symmetry is disabled for both baseline and MRV pairs, so the compared counts do not mix canonical representatives with raw assignments.
